name: Dual Model Supervisor
description: Dual-model supervision: course correction, memory guarding, and safety filtering

enabled.description: Enable or disable the supervisor system

supervisorModel.description: Reviewer model in provider/model format (e.g. openai/gpt-4o-mini). Leave empty to inherit from main model.

reviewMode.description: off=disabled, filter-only=safety filtering only, correct=filter+course correction, full=filter+correction+memory guard

appendReviewToChannelOutput.description: Whether to append review summaries to channel output messages

preReviewFilter.description: Pre-review filtering configuration to skip trivial content

minContentLength.description: Minimum content length to trigger review

gatekeeperMaxInputChars.description: Maximum input characters to send to gatekeeper

alwaysReviewToolCalls.description: Always review messages containing tool calls regardless of other filters

enabled.description: Enable memory guardian (compaction protection + loss detection)

keyCategories.description: Categories of information to protect from compaction

deviationThreshold.description: Deviation score threshold (0-1) above which correction is triggered

forceRegenerate.description: Enable force regeneration on severe deviation

maxRegenerateAttempts.description: Maximum number of regeneration attempts per turn

highRiskTools.description: Tools whose calls will be reviewed before execution
